title: Squeeze
suits: compression, consolidation, summarising, deduplication, cost or size reductions: a pile of pages, logs, layers or files becomes one small thing; shows one before → after number

params.--field: the slide field (workshop green); the pegboard and lamp pool are drawn in its ink
params.--brand: the hand wheel (a light tint, so it reads on the steel), the straps, half the sheet tints
params.--brand-2: the other sheet tints and the tabs
params.data-from / data-to: the before and after numbers on .count (counts down on arrival)
params..st-squeeze-was: the struck before value; .st-squeeze-unit the unit
params.__MARK__: the label on the pressed block

details: the sheets slide in with the top ones lagging, so the stack leans, overshoots and rights itself
the stack starts messy (each sheet nudged and turned a little) and the squeeze squares it up
three coloured tabs stick out of the stack and stay visible as slivers in the pressed block
a paperclip on the top sheet
the hand wheel spins as the press comes down and turns back a little as it lifts
the threaded rod's threads travel with the platen
the platen's shadow darkens and tightens on the stack as it closes in
the block overshoots as the platen lifts (springs up 4%) and settles
the bed jolts 4 px on contact
dust puffs out of both sides at bed height
three paper scraps fly out; two land on the floor, one on the bed, and stay there
the block gets a crisp edge, a file label that drops in with a squash, and two straps that snap on
the number counts down as the stack shrinks and squashes when it lands on its new value
the old value lands above it, faded, with the strike drawn through it
a warm lamp glow at the top of the card
